what: Per-group importance statistics for EfficientDet-Lite1's backbone under the published protocol (global ranking, magnitude_l2, torch_pruning's default normalizer='mean'). Backs the 'Why' subsection of docs/PRUNING_HAZARDS.md section 1. Allocation only, no forward pass.
reading: normalizer='mean' makes every group's mean exactly 1.0, so cross-layer scale is already cancelled and cannot be the driver. What differs is the WITHIN-group shape: narrow early groups have a long left tail (high frac_below_half, high cv), wide late groups have almost none. A single global threshold therefore empties one narrow layer before it touches the wide ones.
